claim: T57: 10262 and 26102 are a reversal ('reverse pair') related by reversal, by an 80-divisor multiple (26102 - 10262 = 15840 = 80*198), and by equal digit sums (both 11)
verdict: REFUTED (headline premise): the pair is NOT a reversal pair - the script itself computes reverse(10262) = 26201, and 26201 != 26102 (and reverse(26102) = 20162). The sub-relations do hold: 26102 - 10262 = 15840 = 80*198 (divisible by 80) and both digit sums are 11 - but these are plain arithmetic, they carry no reversal structure. The prime-gap census [10262, 26102] (1610 primes, max gap 52 at 19609, 0 gaps divisible by 80, 30 by 11) and [26102, 1914467] (140162 primes, max gap 132 at 1357201, 24 gaps divisible by 80) are exact arithmetic over ordinary intervals and contain no signal attributable to the 'reverse pair'; emirps (374) and digit-sum-11 primes (67 = 4.2%) are generic counts. The 9.4e11 endpoint is correctly handled analytically (Lucy_Hedgehog/Lehmer + segmented sieve) rather than by sieve.
